parameters.help_en: The name of the zone to add
parameters.name: zone_name

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable the recursive proxy for subdomains. Valid values:
ZONE: Disabled. When a DNS query is made for a non-existent subdomain under this domain name, NXDOMAIN is directly returned to indicate that the subdomain does not exist.
RECORD: Enabled. When a DNS query is made for a non-existent subdomain under this domain name, the system sequentially queries the forwarding and recursive resolution modules, and responds to the DNS query with the final resolution result.

Default value: ZONE
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启子域名递归代理。取值：
ZONE: 关闭（当解析本域名下不存在的子域名时，直接返回NXDOMAIN，表示子域名不存在）
RECORD: 开启（当解析本域名下不存在的子域名时，会依次查询“转发”和“递归”模块，并以最终查询到的解析结果来应答解析请求）

默认：ZONE

parameters.help_en:
The location zone of the built-in authoritative zone. Valid values:

NORMAL_ZONE: Normal zone. DNS query responses are cached. The system queries the built-in authoritative normal zone only when a cache miss occurs. DNS record changes take effect based on the time-to-live (TTL). Custom line resolution and weighted resolution are not supported.
FAST_ZONE: Fast zone. Recommended. The system directly responds to DNS queries with the lowest resolution latency. Record changes take effect in real time. Custom line resolution and weighted resolution are supported.

Default value: NORMAL_ZONE.

The built-in authoritative accelerated zone is located before the cache module, and resolution results are not cached. Enable https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2592999.html to reduce the increase in DNS queries caused by the lack of local cache, thereby avoiding excessive additional costs.                         

<props="china">Starting April 30, 2025 (UTC+8), when users who newly activate Alibaba Cloud DNS PrivateZone add a zone, the zone is set to an accelerated zone by default.</props>
parameters.help_zh:
内置权威位置区。取值：

NORMAL_ZONE：普通区（解析应答结果会被缓存，缓存不命中的情况下才回源到内置权威普通区，解析变更生效受TTL时间影响；无法使用自定义线路解析、权重解析功能。）
FAST_ZONE：快速区（推荐：直接应答解析请求、解析时延最低，记录变更实时生效；支持自定义线路解析、权重解析。）

默认：NORMAL_ZONE

内置权威加速区在缓存模块前，解析结果不进入缓存，建议为https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2592999.html，以减少无本地缓存引发的解析请求增长，从而避免产生过多额外费用。                         

<props="china">2025年4月30日（UTC+8）起，新开通云解析PrivateZone的用户在添加Zone时，默认将设置为加速区Zone。</props>
